title: Klarna's CEO on why the 'buy now, pay later' economy is a good thing | The Assignment
summary: Klarna's CEO argues in a CNN interview that BNPL is a healthier, interest-free alternative to credit cards.

verdicts.note: True for a user who pays a single plan on schedule, but doesn't hold once someone stacks multiple plans or revolves a balance onto a credit card instead.

CFPB finds BNPL's typical direct cost to consumers is lower than credit cards' (0% vs. a 17.7% average cost of credit), but the same report immediately raises overextension risks -- loan stacking and sustained usage -- that complicate a blanket 'healthier' conclusion.
